units.source_text: 女子从山上客栈的窗口俯视过黎明前的坡道。

en.t: From the window of the mountain inn, the woman had looked down over the slope before dawn.

units.source_text: 过些时候，从年底到正月这段日子，这条坡道将会被暴风雪埋没。

en.t: Before long, during the days from year end to New Year, this slope would be buried in blizzards.
At that time, going to a banquet would mean having to wear snow trousers

units.source_text: \[冬天套在和服外面穿的一种裤子。\]

en.t: [A kind of trousers worn over a kimono in winter.]

units.source_text: 、长统胶靴，还得披斗篷，戴头巾呢。

en.t: and long rubber boots, and one would also have to wrap oneself in a cloak and wear a headscarf.

units.source_text: 到了那时节，积雪会有丈把厚。

en.t: By that season, the snow would be roughly ten feet deep.

units.source_text: 岛村现在正下这条坡道。

en.t: Shimamura was now descending this very slope.

units.source_text: 不过，他从路旁高高地晾晒着的尿布下面，倒是可以望见县境的山峦，

en.t: Even so, beneath the diapers hung high to dry by the roadside, he could see the mountains along the provincial border,

units.source_text: 上面的积雪熠熠生辉，显得格外晴朗。

en.t: their snow gleaming brightly and making the view seem especially clear.

units.source_text: 绿色的葱还没被雪埋掉。

en.t: The green onions had not yet been buried by the snow.
